name: ADMIN SIDEBAR — SHORT VIEWPORT ACCESSIBILITY
changes: Restores vertical scrolling inside the desktop Admin sidebar on short viewport heights so Settings and every navigation item remain reachable
Keeps the sidebar footer pinned outside the navigation scroll area while the navigation itself flexes within the available height
Hides the short-viewport sidebar scrollbar visually so the fix does not reintroduce the heavy rail removed in earlier visual polish
Preserves the v16.4.4 PWA safe-area, Client 360 navigation and all storefront/backend behavior unchanged
notes: Frontend-only Admin sidebar fix based on v16.4.4.
No Supabase migration, Edge Function, table, grant, RLS policy, Monobank, Nova Poshta or VAcleaner object changed.
Root cause was the short-desktop media rule forcing overflow-y:hidden on .admin2-nav.
